name: partial return: a return claws back the drop between the order's granted points and its new worth
note: Member in BRONZE, earnMultiplier 1, no promotion. Order O-9001 has one line of amount 4000: 4000 x 1 = 4000; 4000 / 100 = 40 points, so expectedPoints 40 and expectedLedgerDelta +40; the earn snapshots currencyUnit 100 and the line multiplier 1. Return R-9001 returns 1500 of that line, so the order's new worth is recomputed from the snapshot as (4000 - 1500) x 1 = 2500; 2500 / 100 = 25 points. The clawback is the delta 40 - 25 = 15, so expectedPoints 15, and the ledger takes it back: expectedLedgerDelta -15, consuming the order's own lot from 40 down to 25.
